events.title: HackForums New Theme
events.description: Omniscient introduced a new theme with a sleek, modern background and subtle transparency effects throughout the forum, with plans to continue tweaking the design.

events.title: HackForums Official Roadmap
events.description: Omniscient released an official roadmap outlining 69 planned initiatives aimed at revamping and modernizing HackForums.

events.title: Harassment Policy Removed
events.description: Omniscient removed the long-standing harassment policy between members, citing the time burden of enforcement and his belief that adult members should not require constant moderation.

events.title: Convo Harassment & DOXing Policy
events.description: Following the removal of the harassment policy, Omniscient announced that posting personal information will no longer be enforced against in Convo, since Convo is not intended as a permanent log. The decision sparked mixed reactions.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Natha was awarded Silver Medal, G.O.A.T, and Award Whore. Truth was awarded Green Apple. 7 was awarded Shining Knight. Red Sox was awarded Asswipe. JoseMar was awarded Diamond. Moooookie was awarded DaBomb. sharn was awarded Asskisser and Flamer. Cap was awarded G.O.A.T.

Ethereal was rebranded to The Academy. uid 8080 was removed as a leader of H4CK3R$ and Sociopaths. skull was added as a leader of H4CK3R$. 7 was added as a leader of The Academy. jcole was added as a leader of Gamblers.
